title: PVP Tweaks
description: PVP Tweaks - a resource pack for PVP that makes your game clean and helps improve your skill level.
body:
**PVP Tweaks** - a utility for Minecraft PVP. This pack cleans up your game by removing most of the annoying particles, and replaces sounds with better ones or removes them entirely.

**Main features**
- _Beautiful crystals and outlined cobwebs_
 
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53e7ed487d0a4c5706d004b7255329ff11ee5253.png)
 
- _Low shield_
  
![Low shield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dffa07a7620b13a4587e60cce0109d065f5e2e05_0.webp)

- _No grass_
 
![No grass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4a9a51c67e84499604bdadee9fb8eb5ac62c36c_0.webp)

- _No fire overlay_

![No fire overlay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac0966a2e909db041e463a2fc67e3890d9598986.png)

- _One pixel fire_

![One pixel fire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ee6d41ee366f96bb3a373bf76caed573171d701.png)

- _Bow and crossbow charge indicator_ 
 
![Bow and crossbow charge indicator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19ccb355fb9780796537d2f75dd691681a3b9494.png)

- _No explosion particles and sounds_ (In Gallery)

- _No eating particles_ (In Gallery)  

- _No totem particles_ (In Gallery)

- _Small totem pop overlay_ (In Gallery)

- _No breaking blocks particles_

- _No wind charge and wind burst particles_

- _No firework particles_

- _No potion particles_
